source: Uploaded Honda CB1000R/RA 2008 service manual, page 3-4

intervals.description: At the first 1,000 km only: replace engine oil and filter; inspect brakes, fasteners and steering head bearings. Continue with the recurring schedule below. Honda manual 3-4.
intervals.torque_spec: Oil drain bolt: 30 N·m; oil filter: 26 N·m

intervals.description: Recurring replacement after the first service. Whichever comes first. Manual 3-4, 1-6 and 1-12.
intervals.torque_spec: Oil drain bolt: 30 N·m; oil filter: 26 N·m
intervals.fluid_spec: SAE 10W-30; API SG or higher, excluding energy-conserving oils; JASO T 903 MA. 3.0 L with filter; 2.7 L after draining; 3.6 L after disassembly.

intervals.description: Inspect and correct as necessary. Honda marks this as requiring suitable tools, service information and mechanical qualifications. Manual 3-4.
Inspect; grip free play 2–6 mm. Requires appropriate tools and competence. Manual 3-4 and 1-6.
Inspect and replace if necessary; no fixed replacement interval stated. Service more often in unusually wet or dusty conditions. Manual 3-4.
Clean. Service more often in rain or at full throttle. Manual 3-4.
Inspect every 24,000 km. NGK IMR9E-9HES or DENSO VUH27ES. Do not adjust the iridium plug gap; replace an out-of-specification plug. Manual 3-4 and 3-10.
Replace every 48,000 km. NGK IMR9E-9HES or DENSO VUH27ES; standard gap 0.80–0.90 mm. Manual 3-4, 1-10 and 3-10.
Cold engine below 35°C. Intake 0.16 ± 0.03 mm; exhaust 0.32 ± 0.03 mm. Requires suitable tools and mechanical qualifications. Manual 3-4, 1-7 and 3-11.
Inspect; replacement has its own interval below. Manual 3-4.
Replace every 2 years or at 36,000 km, whichever comes first. Requires mechanical skill. Manual 3-4 note 4 and 1-6.
intervals.fluid_spec: Silicate-free ethylene glycol coolant, 1:1 with distilled water. Radiator/engine 3.0 L; reserve tank 0.35 L.

intervals.description: Inspect and correct as necessary. Requires appropriate tools and competence. Manual 3-4.
Inspect and correct as necessary. Requires appropriate tools and competence. Manual 3-4.
Every 1,000 km. Slack 25–35 mm, ignition off, on sidestand, transmission in neutral. Never inspect or adjust with the engine running. Manual 3-4 and 3-21.
intervals.torque_spec: Rear axle bearing-holder pinch bolt: 74 N·m
intervals.fluid_spec: #80–90 gear oil or lubricant designed for O-ring chains.

intervals.description: Inspect and replace if necessary. Manual 3-4.
Inspect; replacement has its own interval below. Brake repairs require appropriate competence. Manual 3-4.
Replace every 2 years or at 18,000 km, whichever comes first. Requires mechanical skill; follow the procedure for CB1000R or CB1000RA as equipped. Manual 3-4 note 4.
intervals.fluid_spec: DOT 4 brake fluid, front and rear.

intervals.description: Inspect wear indicators; replace if necessary. Brake repairs require appropriate competence. Manual 3-4.
Also inspect at the one-off first service. Brake repairs require appropriate competence. Manual 3-4.
Inspect and correct as necessary. Requires appropriate tools and competence. Manual 3-4.
Inspect and adjust as necessary. Requires appropriate tools and competence. Manual 3-4.
Inspect and correct as necessary. Manual 3-4.
Inspect hydraulic clutch fluid; replacement has its own interval below. Manual 3-4.
Replace every 2 years or at 18,000 km, whichever comes first. Requires mechanical skill. Manual 3-4 note 4 and 1-7.
Inspect and correct as necessary. Manual 3-4.
Inspect and correct as necessary. Requires appropriate tools and competence. Manual 3-4.
Also inspect at the one-off first service. Use the fastener-specific torques and procedures; do not apply a general torque to every fastener. Manual 3-4.

Honda recommends dealer service for this scheduled check. Cold pressures: front 250 kPa (36 psi), rear 290 kPa (42 psi), with or without a passenger. This schedule does not replace pre-ride checks. Manual 3-4 and 1-9.
